def transform(grid):
    # Rotate 180 degrees, then repeat with alternating reflections at tile boundaries.
    tile=[row[::-1] for row in grid[::-1]]
    h,w=len(tile),len(tile[0])
    out=[]
    for r in range(3*h):
        tr=r//h
        row=tile[r%h] if tr%2==0 else tile[h-1-(r%h)]
        out.append((row if tr%2==0 else row[::-1]) * 3)
    # horizontal tile reflection alternates independently
    for r in range(3*h):
        tr=r//h
        base=tile[r%h] if tr%2==0 else tile[h-1-(r%h)]
        out[r]=sum((base if tc%2==0 else base[::-1] for tc in range(3)), [])
    return out
PY
